tldr: Pluto through the 10th house intensifies career, visibility, reputation, pressure, and ambition.
body:
When Pluto moves through your 10th house, it brings pressure to career, visibility, reputation, pressure, ambition, authority, and how you are being seen. You may notice how much attention is on your responsibilities, your public role, or the direction you are trying to build.

Something may no longer stay buried, controlled, avoided, or handled only on the surface. It can help you face the deeper truth and stop spending energy protecting a false version of peace.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a visible choice with more intention.

The caution: Watch for trying to control the outcome so tightly that you cannot tell what is changing naturally. The risk is measuring your whole self by what is productive, impressive, or approved.

Pluto moves through this house for a long chapter. Work with the deeper truth instead of forcing everything back into the old shape.
